spans.s:
नि-वपन (नं) 1.
n. Gifts in honor of
a deceased relative.

नि-वरा (रा) 1.
f. A virgin.

नि-वार (रः) 1.
m. Hindering.

नीवर (रः) 1.
m. Trade; a place, site
of a house; a religious mendi-
cant.
n. Water; mud.

नी-वार (रः) 1.
m. Wild rice.

नि-वर्त्तन (नं) 1.
n. Returning; re-
forming; stopping; giving back;
200 square cubits of land.

नि-वर्त्तयितव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. That
should be restrained or returned.

नि-वर्हण (णं-णा) 1.
n. f. Killing,
destroying; removing.

नि-वर्हित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Killed.

नि-वसति (तिः) 2.
f. A house.

नि-वसथ (थः) 1.
m. A village.

नि-वसन (नं) 1.
n. A house: clothes.

नि-वह (हः) 1.
m. A multitude; a
quantity; one of seven winds.

नि-वात (तः-ता-तं)
a. Well-armed; se-
cure; calm.
n. A calm; asylum.

नि-वात-कवच (चः) 1.
m. A demon.

नि-वाप (पः) 1.
m. Gifts in honour
of deceased friends; any gift.

नि-वारण (णं) 1.
n. Idem.

नि-वारणीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may
be hindered or prohibited.

नि-वारित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Hindered.

नि-वार्य्यमाण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Idem.

नि-वास (सः) 1.
m. A house.

नि-वास-भूय (यं) 1.
n. Habitation.

नि-वासिन् (सी-सिनी-सि)
a. Inhabiting.

नि-विडीष (षः-षा-षं)
a. Idem.

नि-विवृत्सत् (न्-न्ती-त्)
a. Wishing to
return, stop or desist.

नि-विरीस (सः-सा-सं)
a. Gross.

नि-विशेष (षः-षा-षं)
a. Alike.

नि-विष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
p. Entered; seated.

नि-वीत (तं) 1.
n. The brāhmanical
thread.
a. Covered.
n. A veil.

नि-वीतिन् (ती) 5.
m. A
brāhman
with his
paitā, or thread.

नि-वृत (तः-ता-तं)
n. A veil.
a. Sur-
rounded, covered, clothed.

नि-वृत्त (त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
a. Ceased, stop-
ped; reformed; finished; gone.

नि-वृति (तिः) 2.
f. Covering.

नि-वृत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Cessation; re-
form; refusal; prevention.

निवृत्त-कारण (णः-णा-णं)
a. Without
cause or low motive.
m. A good
or disinterested man.

निवृत्त-राग (गः-गा-गं)
a. Of subdued
passions, feelings or temper.

निवृत्त-वृत्ति (त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
a. Leaving a
trade or occupation.

निवृत्ति-धर्म्म-निरत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Ceas-
ing from works as a means of
obtaining final salvation.

नि-वेदन (नं) 1.
n. Delivering an
address, or gift; entreaty.

नि-वेदित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Given, ad-
dressed, entreated, stated.

नि-वेद्य
ind. Having stated.

नि-वेश (शः) 1.
m. Entrance; deposi-
ting; a camp; a palace; array;
marriage; entering.

नि-वेशन (नं) 1.
n. A house; a city.

नि-वेशनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may
be entered or engaged in.

नि-व्यूढ (ढं) 1.
n. Perseverance.

नी-वाक (कः) 1.
m. Dearth, scarcity.

नीवि (विः-वी) 2. 3.
f. Capital; stock;
wager; cloth round a woman's
waist, or the knot into which it
is gathered; outer tie of a pack-
et containing
sudra offerings.

नीवृत् (त्)
a. Any inhabited country.
